channel.title: The Parameter
channel.description: The Parameter is an AI publication covering news, trends, tools, model releases, research and practical applications, with every claim tied to a source.

item.title: Inside the New AI Model: What Changed, Who Benefits, and What Remains Uncertain
item.description: A worked method for reading any model announcement: separate what the vendor changed from what independent evaluation can confirm, and name what stays unknown.

item.title: Inside the AI Infrastructure Race: Why Computing Capacity Is Becoming a Strategic Advantage
item.description: Chips, memory, networking and electricity now shape which companies can train and serve frontier models. A guide to reading partnership and investment announcements.

item.title: Beyond Chatbots: How AI Agents Are Changing the Way Software Gets Work Done
item.description: Agents let a model plan, call tools and check results in a loop. What that enables in practice, where it breaks, and how to decide whether a task needs one.

item.title: Five Types of AI Research Tools Worth Evaluating for Faster, More Reliable Knowledge Work
item.description: Search assistants, document readers, citation checkers, data analysts and note systems compared by use case and limitation. Pricing is deliberately omitted until verified.

item.title: Choosing an AI Model: How to Compare Reasoning, Speed, Cost, and Reliability
item.description: Public leaderboards answer a different question from yours. Build a small test set, measure four properties, and let the numbers from your own tasks decide.

item.title: From Content Production to Pipeline: Where AI Can Improve a Marketing Workflow
item.description: Map a marketing workflow stage by stage, mark where a model drafts and where a person decides, and measure the result against pipeline instead of output volume.

item.title: What the Latest AI Research Actually Demonstrates, and What It Does Not
item.description: A reader's guide to AI papers: separate the measurement from the headline, check what the benchmark covers, and watch for the leap from correlation to capability.

item.title: AI Governance in Practice: What Organizations Need to Verify Before Deployment
item.description: Frameworks, regulation and security guidance reduced to a pre-deployment verification list covering risk, data, security, oversight and legal obligations.

item.title: Build a Repeatable AI Research Workflow: From Source Collection to Evidence-Based Reporting
item.description: A six-step method for using a model as a research assistant while keeping sources, claims and verification under your control.

item.title: Where AI Is Heading Next: Five Developments to Watch and the Evidence Behind Them
item.description: Agents, cheaper inference, better evaluation, tighter regulation and energy limits: five developments, the evidence for each, and what would change our assessment.
